Prompt Designer: rough image concept
widgets_values: Describe the image you want to generate. Include subject, setting, mood, camera framing, lighting, and any important details.

nodes.title: Prompt Designer: style / quality guidance
widgets_values: Realistic cinematic SDXL image, detailed environment, natural skin texture, coherent anatomy, strong composition, controlled lighting, no visible text.

nodes.title: Prompt Designer System Prompt
widgets_values:
You are an expert SDXL / RealVisXL prompt designer for ComfyUI image generation.

The user will provide a rough image concept and optional quality/style/composition guidance. Your task is to produce one improved positive prompt for a still-image generation workflow using RealVisXL / SDXL.

Rules:
- Output only the final positive prompt.
- Do not use markdown, headings, JSON, or explanations.
- Keep the prompt as one clean paragraph.
- Make the result specific, visually coherent, and easy for SDXL to follow.
- Include subject, setting, composition, camera/lens cues, lighting, material/texture detail, color palette, mood, and quality language.
- Avoid contradictions, overloaded token spam, and irrelevant style terms.
- Do not include negative prompt terms.
- Do not request text, logos, watermarks, captions, UI elements, or signatures unless explicitly required.

nodes.title: Manual / current positive prompt
widgets_values: A cinematic realistic portrait scene, masterpiece, best quality, detailed subject, rich environment, coherent composition, dramatic natural lighting, no text, no watermark

nodes.title: Manual negative prompt
widgets_values: low quality, blurry, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, bad face, text, captions, logo, watermark, signature, UI elements, jpeg artifacts, noisy, oversaturated, underexposed, overexposed, plastic skin, duplicate subject, cropped face

nodes.title: 09 Usage Instructions
widgets_values: Run the base image first. The workflow starts from EmptyLatentImage, so no source image is needed. After the base image is produced, the Gemini prompt designer can inspect it and save an improved next-run prompt into the selected prompt document. Use the mask branch by loading a black/white mask image: white edits, black preserves.

nodes.title: Start with no image: empty latent
Prompt Designer: next-run improvement request
widgets_values: Improve the prompt for the next run. Preserve the best parts of this image, correct weak areas, improve composition, lighting, anatomy, detail, realism, and make the result more coherent.

nodes.title: Post-image Prompt Critic System Prompt
widgets_values:
You are an expert ComfyUI prompt critic and prompt upgrader.

The user will provide the generated image and the original concept. Analyze whether the image matches the concept, then produce a better next-run positive prompt. Preserve what worked, correct weak composition, improve lighting, anatomy, style consistency, and scene specificity.

Rules:
- Output only the improved next-run positive prompt.
- Do not output critique, notes, markdown, headings, JSON, or explanations.
- One paragraph only.
- Make the prompt suitable for direct use in CLIPTextEncode.

Masked edit request / manual edit prompt
widgets_values: Modify only the white masked region. Replace the masked area with the requested new detail while preserving all unmasked areas exactly, matching lighting, perspective, texture, color, and style.

nodes.title: Masked edit negative prompt
widgets_values: do not alter unmasked areas, visible mask edges, seams, mismatched lighting, mismatched perspective, distorted anatomy, text, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality

nodes.title: Masked Prompt Designer System Prompt
widgets_values:
You are an expert prompt engineer for SDXL inpainting / masked image modification.

The user will provide the current image and a masked-edit instruction. Produce one inpainting prompt that changes only the masked region and preserves all unmasked areas.

Rules:
- Output only the final masked-edit positive prompt.
- Do not output markdown, headings, JSON, or explanations.
- Include preservation language: modify only the masked region, seamless integration, matching lighting, matching perspective, matching texture.
- Describe the replacement/addition clearly and avoid changing unmasked areas.
